subscriptions.reviewNote: Premium (annual and monthly, sold without a trial period) unlocks all 21 paid learning paths and unlimited Oracle chat. The paywall appears after the first finished lesson and then at most every third finished lesson (three offers in all), when a locked path's preview ends, when a locked path or book is tapped, from the Premium Week chip on Home, when the per-deity free Oracle limit is reached, once when the Premium Week ends, and from Profile > View Paths to Ascension. It is always dismissible: the Judaism path and 3 free Oracle consultations per deity remain available without paying. The Premium Week is not a store trial: finishing the Judgment quiz (shown at first launch, and from Home > Face the Judgment) opens every path for seven days for someone who owns nothing, with no purchase, no sign-up and nothing that renews. Single paths, the three deity packs (reached from the Oracle when a deity's free consultations run out), Oracle Wisdom and Ultimate (lifetime) are one-time purchases that work alongside the subscription. The Oracle runs on device: on iPhones with Apple Intelligence it answers at once, on other iPhones it asks for a one-time model download over Wi-Fi. No account or sign-in is required.
